scope: Identity, duplicate, overlap and frozen scaffold-split audit only. ChEMBL assay descriptions are not treated as primary-source eligibility; source status is reported separately.
identity_policy: Reuse Phase 19 identity rule: molecule ID, canonical isomeric SMILES, and achiral SMILES overlap exclusions; collapse identical isomeric structures only when exact values agree; enforce 1-128 heavy atoms and one fragment. Conflicting duplicate groups are excluded in full.
split_policy: Reuse Phase 19 split seed cryo-phase19-split-1900 with whole achiral Murcko scaffold groups; no potency-based selection.
